services.name: Guided Kayak Tour
services.desc: Here’s your chance to take in some of the most breathtaking scenery of the Niagara River. Join one of our experienced tour guides as you paddle your kayak through marshes and around islands that played a pivotal role in the settlement of the Niagara Frontier. See the boyhood home of former U.S. President Grover Cleveland on Grand Island and check out the nesting Herons and Egrets on nearby Motor Island. Land your kayak at Strawberry Island for a brief respite and lounge on a beach of glacially flattened pebbles that were deposited thousands of years ago at the end of the Wisconsin Ice

blurb: Guests can rent individual or tandem sit-in or sit-on kayaks and stand up paddle boards for a minimum of 2 hours to explore the Upper Niagara River on their own. The marina also offers full service boat repair, seasonal dockage, boat sales, and winter storage. Located on Grand Island, NY, between Buffalo and Niagara Falls.
